name: Gnoll Infestation
summary: Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch asks you to thin the Redridge gnolls. Their numbers make the northern passage dangerous and threaten people beyond Farholde Keep.

sections.title: A Threat Nearby
sections.body: Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch faces gnolls across the hills beyond the post. Their numbers make passage north dangerous, and people outside Farholde Keep are at risk. You are asked to reduce their hold on the area by killing Redridge Mystics, Trappers, and Brutes.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls a problem?
faq.answer: The gnolls are aggressive and numerous. They make passage north dangerous and threaten people living outside Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Who asks me to deal with the gnolls?
faq.answer: Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch asks you to reduce the gnoll threat.
The Redridge Mystics, Redridge Trappers, and Redridge Brutes are named as the gnolls to kill.
They infest the hills beyond Southern Watch, making passage to the north dangerous.
